CHELL-OH! launches Australian-made liqueurs with backing from Maybe Group

by Alexandra Zinghini
0

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 2:10
Instaread

Chef Alex Prichard and bartender Matty Opai have launched CHELL-OH!, an Australian-made liqueur range featuring Lemon and Melon expressions, with Stefano Catino and Vince Lombardo of the Maybe Group joining as partners.

Former Icebergs Dining Room and Bar Head Chef Alex Prichard and Group Beverage Director Matty Opai have launched CHELL-OH!, an Australian-made liqueur brand inspired by Italian limoncello, with the Maybe Group’s Stefano Catino and Vince Lombardo joining as partners in 2026.

The range features two expressions, Lemon and Melon, developed for use in cocktails, chilled serves and longer mixed drinks.

The brand originated from a house-made limoncello developed by Prichard and Opai at Icebergs, with Prichard experimenting with sweetness, acidity and salt, using hand-zested citrus, lemon leaves and fresh lemon juice. The pair later developed a Melon expression.

“None of us are stuck on ‘this is how it’s traditionally done, so this is how it has to be done’,” says Prichard.

Lemon is designed for use in Spritzes and Sgroppinos, alongside straight chilled serves, while Melon offers a green fruit profile suited to highballs and soda-based drinks.

The partnership with Catino and Lombardo will support CHELL-OH!’s expansion, with further expressions planned for the range.

To mark the launch, CHELL-OH! has introduced Terraza, a summer activation at the Maybe Group’s El Primo Sanchez in Surry Hills, featuring cocktails and boozy soft serves made with the liqueurs.

The offering includes two soft serves: Salted Melon, combining CHELL-OH! Melon and citrus, and Super Lemon, made with CHELL-OH! Lemon, yuzu and lemon olive oil.

Limoncello Spritzes also feature alongside cocktails from the Maybe Sammy team, including Lychee Martinis, Jasmine Negronis and Eucalyptus Gimlets.

The activation operates every Friday and Saturday from 2pm to 8pm at El Primo Sanchez, 410 Crown Street, Surry Hills.

“I can’t think of a single occasion where I’ve enjoyed myself and wouldn’t have liked CHELL-OH! to be there,” says Prichard.

The product is bottled at 22 per cent ABV and Melon at 20 per cent ABV, with both available in 700ml bottles.

The range is available online, at Icebergs Dining Room and Bar and across Maybe Group venues, with additional retail stockists to be announced.
